blocks.p: Photosynthesis turns light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose. It happens in the chloroplasts of plant cells, mostly in the leaves.

list: Light reactions happen in the thylakoid membranes and make ATP and NADPH.
The Calvin cycle happens in the stroma and uses ATP and NADPH to fix CO_{2}.
Water is split, which releases O_{2}.

table: Note: rate limited by light, CO_{2} and temperature
Green pigment that absorbs red and blue light
Pores that let CO_{2} in and O_{2} out
Enzyme that fixes CO_{2} in the Calvin cycle

blocks.note: Tip: C4 and CAM plants reduce photorespiration by separating steps in space or time.
